changes: Extracted CLI command catalog/schema definitions from cli-engine.ts into focused packages/main/src/cli modules, preserved compatibility exports, and added command-catalog-smoke coverage for command inventory, host wording, dry-run guidance, and owner lease help.
usage: Run lattice commands as before, for example node bin/lattice.js story_advance --help or npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke; import compatibility symbols from cli-engine.ts still compiles.
expectedOutcome: Expected transcript shows lattice story_advance help still includes --dryRun and Owner lease meta options, and command catalog smoke passes with the full command inventory.
actualTranscript: node bin/lattice.js story_advance --help printed --dryRun plus Owner lease meta options with --takeover and --forceTakeover; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke printed command catalog smoke passed: 239 commands.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible behavior difference observed; the change is internal modularization plus stronger smoke coverage.
limitations: No Authority Server production receipt is claimed; host verdicts are local non-authority evidence only. This story does not extract flags, aliases, runtime ownership gates, or lifecycle dispatch.
pitfalls: Initial test-coverage review found F-001 because the smoke promised dry-run/owner lease coverage without assertions; fixed by adding explicit story_advance help assertions before TEST.
